basics.name: Ivan Gegov
basics.label: AI Systems Builder · Agent Orchestration · RAG & Automation
basics.summary: AI systems builder who designs, ships, and operates multi-agent fleets, orchestration and control planes, long-term memory and retrieval systems, and full-stack AI web products. Work combines provider-aware LLM workflows, source-grounded RAG, structured evaluation, automation pipelines, and production-minded delivery across Windows, VPS, Oracle, GCP, Vercel, and private model infrastructure.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Self-directed engineering and operations across agentic software, retrieval, automation, interactive web products, and the infrastructure that keeps them observable and safe.
highlights: Built and operates a multi-agent development fleet (Hermes/Dispatch) with shared project contracts, task routing, evidence receipts, and a local control dashboard.
Designed source-backed memory and retrieval systems that preserve raw events, expose searchable recall, and keep citations and provenance attached to answers.
Implemented provider-aware workflows across Claude managed agents, Claude Code, OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenRouter, Ollama/local routers, and deterministic fallbacks.
Operates delivery across Vercel, VPS/Oracle, Caddy, systemd, Docker/Compose, GCP Secret Manager, n8n, GitHub Actions, and Windows Task Scheduler.
